quiet: Use gloves when you lift the heavy crate off the truck.
Cover the bowl with a damp cloth and leave the salad in the fridge.
Never set wet glasses straight from the sink onto a wooden table.
Peel the cucumbers and let the slices chill in the bowl for twenty minutes.
Take the clean plate off the rack and put the cups away.
Scientists warn that warming oceans will raise temperatures along the coast.
Rinse the lettuce at the sink until no grit is left on it.
Pull the wool blanket from the closet and spread it over the bed.
